reason_free_text: The page publishes the four emotion fields (joyLikelihood, sorrowLikelihood, angerLikelihood, surpriseLikelihood) and the ordered enum UNKNOWN / VERY_UNLIKELY / UNLIKELY / POSSIBLE / LIKELY / VERY_LIKELY, i.e. a 6-value quantisation. The Cloud console demo does show the words, but no public spec documents that rendering. Population definition requires a component that draws to a human viewer, so excluded. JUDGMENT CALL - recorded because this is otherwise the cleanest published quantisation found in S4.
